verdict.rationale: A single /convert endpoint accepts "a PDF, image, or document" and returns Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks. The docs explicitly name PDFs, Word docs, and spreadsheets, and DOCX is confirmed as an input for track changes, so the core one-API approach works for part of the mix. The evidence never names PPTX, HTML, or email (EML/MSG) as inputs, so only about half of the listed format mix is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit PPTX, HTML and email input support, a published supported-formats list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.
